initialExam.title: SSC CPO Sub-Inspector 2026 (II)
initialExam.description: Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and CAPF through SSC CPO examination. Prestigious uniformed service post.
initialExam.syllabus: Paper-I: GI & Reasoning (50Q), GK & GA (50Q), Quant Aptitude (50Q), English (50Q). Paper-II: English Language (200Q).
initialExam.examPattern: Paper-I: 200Q, 200 marks, 2 hrs. Paper-II: 200Q, 200 marks, 2 hrs. PET/PST mandatory.
initialExam.jobRole: Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police, BSF, CISF, CRPF, ITBP, SSB
initialExam.careerGrowth: SI → Inspector → DSP/ACP → SP/DCP through promotions.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit ssc.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Uniform Allowance, Risk Allowance, Medical, Pension
